bands.label: Above C1
bands.descriptor: Performance is likely to be above the C1 level.

bands.label: C1
bands.descriptor: The presentation is clear, highlighting points from each section. Gives reasons in support of and against particular points of view.

bands.label: Higher B2
bands.descriptor: The response addresses the points from each section + Question 7 B2 features.

bands.label: Lower B2
bands.descriptor: The response addresses the points from only one of the sections + Question 7 B2 features.

bands.label: Higher B1
bands.descriptor: The candidate is unable to construct a coherent and sustained response and is heavily dependent on the input prompts. + Question 7 B1 features.

bands.label: Lower B1
bands.descriptor: The candidate is unable to construct a coherent and sustained response and reads directly from the input prompts. + Question 7 B1 features.

bands.label: Below B1
bands.descriptor: Performance is below B1, or there is no meaningful language, or all responses are completely off-topic.

C1.grammar: A range of complex grammar constructions are used accurately. Some minor errors occur but do not impede understanding.
C1.vocabulary: A range of vocabulary is used to discuss the topic required by the task. There is some awkward usage or slightly inappropriate word choices.
C1.fluency: Backtracking and reformulations do not fully interrupt the flow of speech.
C1.cohesion: A range of cohesive devices are used to clearly indicate the links between ideas.

B2.grammar: Some complex grammar constructions are used accurately. Errors do not impede understanding.
B2.vocabulary: The range of vocabulary is sufficient to discuss the topics required by the task. Inappropriate lexical choices do not impede understanding.
B2.pronunciation: Pronunciation is intelligible. Mispronunciations do not put a strain on the listener or lead to misunderstanding.
B2.fluency: Some pausing while searching for vocabulary but this does not put a strain on the listener.
B2.cohesion: A limited number of cohesive devices are used to indicate the links between ideas.

B1.grammar: Simple grammatical structures are used correctly. Errors occur when attempting complex structures.
B1.vocabulary: Limitations in vocabulary make it difficult to deal fully with the task.
B1.pronunciation: Pronunciation is generally intelligible but mispronunciations put an occasional strain on the listener.
B1.fluency: There is some pausing, false starts, and reformulations.
B1.cohesion: Uses only simple cohesive devices. Links between ideas are not always clearly indicated.

below_B1.grammar: Some simple grammatical structures are used correctly but basic mistakes systematically occur.
below_B1.vocabulary: Vocabulary is sufficient to respond to the questions, although inappropriate word choices are noticeable.
below_B1.pronunciation: Mispronunciations are noticeable and frequently place a strain on the listener.
below_B1.fluency: There is frequent pausing, false starts, and reformulations.
below_B1.cohesion: Cohesion between ideas is limited. Responses tend to be a list of points.

descriptor_sources.C1: Official UZBMB Multilevel speaking rating scale, Question 8, band 5 (C1).
descriptor_sources.B2: Official UZBMB Multilevel speaking rating scale, Question 7, B2 (Question 8 bands 3 and 4 refer to the Question 7 B2 features).
descriptor_sources.B1: Official UZBMB Multilevel speaking rating scale, Question 7, B1 (Question 8 bands 1 and 2 refer to the Question 7 B1 features).
descriptor_sources.below_B1: Reference only: the official 'Higher A2' text from Questions 4-6, used only to recognise below-B1 language (as in Question 7).
descriptor_sources.above_C1: No feature text: Question 8 band 6 says only 'likely above the C1 level'. Judged only when the evidence clearly exceeds every C1 descriptor.
